translation.name: Fairy – Warrior
profile: A fairy warrior may protect the route to the community, accompany a vulnerable ally, or leave a safe home because of an important oath. This combat role does not rely on brute strength. The character needs suitable light equipment and a thoughtful approach, yet can still decide whom to protect at a critical moment. Wings and appearance belong to the story; they do not by themselves add another combat bonus or a rule granting unrestricted flight.

Within the party, the warrior helps keep danger away from more vulnerable allies and gives them room to make decisions. The character may guard a retreat, accompany a negotiator, or hold an important passage. The role is useful outside combat too: protecting travelers, preparing an expedition, and handling situations where someone needs support. Courage may mean admitting a mistake or choosing a safer route, rather than accepting every challenge.

The racial ability Fairy Dust makes every healing performed by the fairy restore one extra HP. The class adds Protect: once per battle, the warrior may take an attack directed at a nearby ally. The attack is resolved against the warrior's defense instead. Choose starting equipment according to the requirements this particular hero meets. The listed values form the basis of a level-one character; personality, name, relationships, and the reason for adventuring are decided during character creation.

strings.Doporučená sestava z finálního Katalogu: Recommended loadout from the final Equipment Catalog v1.0.
strings.Počítáno přesně jako základ 5 + rasa + p: Calculated exactly as base 5 + race + class.
strings.1× za dobrodružství po vlastním neúspěšn: Once per adventure, reroll your own failed roll. Vaelor creates a new random permutation; choose a number again and use the better of the two results.
strings.1× za souboj může převzít útok mířící na: Once per battle, take an attack aimed at a nearby ally. Resolve the attack against the warrior's defense instead.
strings.Krátký meč · Střední štít · Prošívaná zb: Short Sword · Medium Shield · Padded Armor
strings.Automaticky si všimne vzdáleného viditel: Automatically notice a distant visible detail, tracks, or movement unless magically or objectively hidden.
strings.V relevantním kamenném/podzemním prostře: In a relevant stone or underground environment, automatically identify cavities, secret passages, unstable rock, high-quality ore, or unusual properties of stone.
strings.Když má méně než polovinu maximálních Ž,: While below half of maximum HP, gain +1 to the result of every melee attack.
strings.1× za dobrodružství po vlastním neúspěšn: Once per adventure, turn your own failed virtual roll into a narrow success. Do not reroll; this is the minimum success required, with no extra advantage.
strings.Automaticky pozná směr, kterým odešla hl: Automatically determine the direction in which a sought person or animal departed, provided usable tracks exist.
strings.Krátký luk · Dýka · Vrhací nůž · Kožená: Short Bow · Dagger · Throwing Knife · Leather Armor
strings.Automaticky pozná, že předmět, místo neb: Automatically recognize that an object, place, or being is magical. This alone does not reveal the magic's exact type, purpose, trigger, or danger.
strings.Při běžném plížení Vaelor předpokládá ús: Vaelor assumes success during ordinary sneaking. Only an exceptional obstacle requires a roll; this ability does not allow hiding where it is objectively impossible.
strings.1× za souboj obnoví sobě nebo jednomu sp: Once per battle, restore ⌈INT/2⌉ HP to yourself or one ally, up to their maximum. This is not a healing spell and does not consume the magical healing limit.
strings.Jednou v daném souboji nebo významné scé: Once in a given battle or significant scene, after a virtual roll is revealed, raise your own or an ally's roll bonus by one step, up to that category's maximum. Does not require a main action; cannot be used on an enemy.
strings.Krátký meč · Dýka · Kožená zbroj · 1 hud: Short Sword · Dagger · Leather Armor · 1 musical instrument of your choice
strings.Každé léčení provedené vílou obnoví o 1: Every healing performed by the fairy restores 1 extra HP.
